{{Quote|Watching the skies.|An AT-AA pilot|<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
The '''All Terrain Anti Aircraft (AT-AA)''' was a quick-moving, quadrupedal, mobile anti-aircraft [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Eaw_at-aa.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Multiple views of an AT-AA]]

The AT-AA had four stubby legs and lizard-like locomotion, along with a low profile not seen in other Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. On most models, the only weapon was a turreted [[Anti-aircraft flak pod|flak pod]], capable of firing several types of ordnance.<ref name="db" /> Other versions could be equipped with one or three rocket-launching tubes.<ref name="RECG" /> Initially the AT-AA had an inability to fire at ground targets. This was partially rectified with the addition of gun ports to allow the crew to fend off infantry attacks.<ref name="RECG" />

Some variation had flak pods replaced with concussion missile launchers.<ref name="RECG" /> The AT-AA also carried electronic countermeasure systems that could scramble missile guidance systems, thus lowering the risk of missile strikes.<ref name="db" />

==History==
{{Quote|Move! Move!|Unnamed AT-AA pilot|<ref name="EaW" />}}
[[File:AT-AA1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|AT-AAs firing]]

Its preliminary designs were developed as far back as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the design began production early on in the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="db" /> The walker saw action during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where it was used against aircraft, but was useless against any ground vehicles.<ref name="RECG" /> Although the troopers aboard could fix blaster rifle mounts on the vehicle, the AT-AA still relied heavily on escorting infantry vehicles,<ref name="db" /> including AT-STs.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

During the [[Battle of Kalaan]], AT-AA batteries protected the armored columns from airborne enemies, bringing down scores of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]].<ref name="FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref>

AT-AAs were used even in the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], where they [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|defended]] the [[Coruscant/Legends|galactic capital]] from the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]].<ref name="SWGBCC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The AT-AA is the only Imperial siege weapon originating from the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] to appear in all three of the major ''[[Star Wars]]'' RTS games.<ref name="GC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref><ref name="FC" /><ref name="EaW" />
